phenotype_specificity.statement: Cohort-level only. The paper gives no clinical features per person; each Table 1 row gives only the LAD-I expression type. No testing of other genes is reported.

quotes.quote: Characteristic features are delayed separation of the umbilical cord and strong leukocytosis, especially neutrophilia, during periods of infection.
The patients suffer from recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections and from impaired wound healing.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Intronic variant 12 nt upstream of exon 6 (intron 5 ends at c.499_500 per the paper), predicted protein p.? in the batch. The authors list it as a splice-site mutation giving 'Deletion part of exon 6 p.Gly167ValfsX47'; the paper does not say whether this was shown on patient RNA. The paper describes LAD-I as autosomal recessive and caused by decreased expression or function of CD18 (beta-2 integrin).

concerns: 22134107 is a mutation-database update: the variant appears only as a Table 1 row with an accession number, with no case description, sex, clinical phenotype, zygosity or parental testing.

Protein differs from the batch prediction: the paper gives 'Deletion part of exon 6 p.Gly167ValfsX47', the batch gives p.? (protein_check 'differs'). The paper says consequences were checked with Mutalyzer; the source of the RNA consequence is not stated.
The row gives 1 family with 2 alleles and one accession (A0033); no other row lists A0033; zygosity not stated (footnote b not attached).
Table 2 of the same paper lists an intronic polymorphism at the adjacent position c.500-11 (c.500-11G/T); the panel may want to check the intronic reference sequence at c.500-12/-11.
22134107 numbers cDNA from the A of the ATG (+1), which matches the batch numbering; it names no RefSeq transcript (it mentions GenBank M15395 only for the offset).
notes_for_panel: Previously published (refs [3, 22]) plus Unpubl. Splice effect stated by the authors.
